ns2:section.sectionText: This section is only available in a 16-week self-paced online format as part of the academic year term (not summer term). Registration for the self-paced class is done through https://netmath.illinois.edu/register/college <https://netmath.illinois.edu/register/college> (not self-service). This course requires access to Mathematica-based courseware. Students will receive information about how to sign up for an account in CAS-ILE ($99) after enrollment in the course. Please contact netmath@illinois.edu <mailto:netmath@illinois.edu> with any questions.
